messages:
maya: FYI I just tried onboarding the new Vercel edge sample with @redwood/sdk@2.1.0 and hit a hard import error in the edge runtime. Repro is tiny — import fails with "Unexpected token 'export'" when importing the SDK from an edge function.

liam: ugh. did this start after the exports map change we shipped this morning?

maya: yes, we switched package.json to conditional exports so Node picks ESM by default. Example part of package.json we shipped:
```json
"exports": {
  ".": {
    "node": {"import": "./dist/index.mjs", "require": "./dist/index.cjs"},
    "edge": "./dist/edge/index.mjs",
    "default": "./dist/index.cjs"
  }
}
```

ashley: the edge runtime on Vercel respects the .mjs entry and treats it as ESM, but our SDK still exposes a few CJS-only shims (auth/retry hooks) which reference require() internally. So edges crash. Typings also broke for TS projects using moduleResolution: node16.

liam: that explains the "export" parse error. Do we have a quick revert? we already bumped a lot of sample apps to 2.1.0.

maya: I put a hotfix PR up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/432 — it adds an explicit `exports.edge` entry pointing to an edge-compatible bundle that contains no require() calls and a small ESM-only auth adapter.

devex-bot: @liam requested changes on PR #432 — CI failed on edge-smoke (error: mismatch in globalThis handling).

liam: looking. also we need to add a migration note in the changelog: some customers using older bundlers (esbuild with legacy commonjs) might need to pin moduleResolution or use the legacy entry.

ashley: action items I suggest:
- revert published package to 2.0.9 while we patch (short-term)
- backport edge-compatible bundle to 2.1.x and publish 2.1.1 (contains fix and adjusted exports map)
- add an integration test that runs the Vercel edge runtime smoke in CI (via playwright or vercel dev)
- add a short onboarding note in docs: "If you are targeting edge runtimes, prefer import from '@redwood/sdk/edge' or pin to 2.0.x"

maya: agreed. I've drafted the docs change here: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/87 — includes code snippets showing both import styles and bundler flags.

liam: question about auth/retry parity — does the edge bundle fully support the same retry semantics as server? we had to stub a few things for fetch timeout behavior.

ashley: not 100% parity yet. Edge bundle has a lighter retry with exponential backoff but no socket-level abort handling. We should call that out in the SDK stable/edge section. Also add an eval (tiny regression test) around auth token refresh to ensure behavior is consistent.

sre-bot: Incident created: #INC-2026 - Edge sample onboarding broken by SDK exports map (severity: low, owner: devex).

maya: I'll coordinate the revert + patch release. ETA for 2.1.1 is EOD today if CI passes.

liam: thanks — once patched let's run a quick sweep of our public examples repos to bump to 2.1.1 and run vercel-dev smoke. I'll own the CI integration story for edge runtimes.

ashley: and I'll add a typed-exports unit test in the repo to catch moduleResolution/typing regressions.

maya: closing loop — will post here when 2.1.1 is published. Sorry for the onboarding friction everyone :/ :pray:
